# Copilot Instructions

## Repository Purpose
This repository is a cybersecurity student's professional GitHub portfolio.

## Documentation Requirements
- Accurately document education history, certifications, and technical projects.
- Keep project descriptions factual, specific, and up to date.
- Clearly state project scope, tools used, and your actual contributions.

## Markdown Quality Standards
- Use clear headings, short sections, and readable bullet lists.
- Keep formatting consistent and professional across files.
- Use concise language, correct grammar, and descriptive link text.

## Security and Privacy Rules
- Never include personal information beyond what is intentionally public for professional use.
- Never expose credentials, API keys, tokens, secrets, or private infrastructure details.
- Redact sensitive identifiers, internal URLs, IPs, and non-public system details.

## Truthfulness and Integrity
- Never invent qualifications, certifications, work history, or completed projects.
- If a project is incomplete, label it clearly as in progress.
- Do not claim outcomes that are not verified.

## Communication Style
- Explain significant repository changes in beginner-friendly language.
- Use simple terms first, then add technical detail only when helpful.

## Change Scope
- Keep each repository change small, focused, and easy to review.
- Avoid unrelated edits in the same update.
